decision.reason: [ev-17bb38a28de1] is only a table-of-contents link, "External secret stores", under "Removed features". That supports a removal, but it does not say which concrete thing was removed (a feature gate, a CLI flag, a CRD kind or field), so the subject family and name can't be settled. "protocol-behavior" doesn't fit a product feature like this, and nothing in the excerpt supports "product-relationship" either. To decide, we need the body of the #external-secret-stores section of the upgrade guide.
